description: Extract policy and claim information from a property loss or damage claim form.

fieldSchema.name: PropertyClaimComparisonFields
fieldSchema.description: Policyholder, policy, loss, and address fields used for a service comparison.

PolicyholderFirstName.description: Policyholder given name in the Policy and Claim Information section.

PolicyholderLastName.description: Policyholder family name in the Policy and Claim Information section.

TelephoneNumber.description: Policyholder telephone number, preserving the number shown on the form.

PolicyNumber.description: Unique policy number adjacent to the Policy Number label.

CoverageType.description: Coverage type adjacent to the Coverage type label.

ClaimNumber.description: Unique claim number adjacent to the Claim Number label.

PolicyEffectiveDate.description: Policy effective date, not the loss date or prepared date.

PolicyExpirationDate.description: Policy expiration date, not the loss date or prepared date.

DamageDeductibleAmount.description: Monetary damage deductible in the policy information table.

DateOfDamageOrLoss.description: Calendar date when the property damage or loss occurred.

TimeOfLoss.description: Time of day when the property loss occurred.

DatePrepared.description: Date on which the claim form was prepared.

PropertyAddress.description: Full street, city, state, and ZIP address of the damaged property.

MailingAddress.description: Full policyholder mailing address, which may differ from the property address.
